name: Truckee River Fund (Community Foundation of Northern Nevada)
summary: Grants for projects that protect and improve water quality in the Truckee River watershed, such as invasive species control, erosion reduction, revegetation after fire and creek rehabilitation. Registered nonprofits and government entities apply.

eligibility.rule: Be a registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit agency, nonprofit educational institution, or governmental entity
Begin the project within 180 days of the award
Do not acquire titled property, including land, buildings, or vehicles
Keep projects outside the Lake Tahoe Basin except along the Truckee River mainstem below Lake Tahoe Dam

documents: Budget template included with the RFP

eligibility.quote: Applicants must be registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit agencies, nonprofit educational institutions, or governmental entities.
Projects must begin within 180 days of award.
TRF will not fund the acquisition of any titled property (e.g., land, buildings, vehicles).
TRF will not fund projects within the Lake Tahoe Basin, except along the mainstem of the Truckee River below Lake Tahoe Dam.

co_finance.quote: All applicants must provide a match of at least 25% for the dollars requested. The match may be funded by the applicant and/or through in-kind services.

after_award.quote: All grantees will be required to sign a grant agreement stipulating their agreement to all applicable terms, conditions, and reporting requirements.
